title: glosa human mastery gate
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements methodology/P17_human_mastery_gate.md (HU-1, design/SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §11.1, hu.mastery-gate-wired, build_now): the genre-independent form of the ten-question live unaided-defense checklist already stated verbatim at templates/paper/arxiv-twocol/main.tex:375-378 (and its onecol twin). Feeds methodology/P10_publish_gate.md's new R8 dimension. Every answer field is human-authored ONLY -- never `ai_filled` (mirrors standpoint.declared_basis's non-delegable rule, P01); an AI may prompt the human through the ten questions but never fills an answer on the human's behalf (P17 'Non-delegable'). Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

artifact_ref.description: The L3+ artifact (claim_card.claim_id, release_manifest.manifest_id, or equivalent) this gate defends. One gate per artifact -- not shared across artifacts.

gate_status.description: P17 'Inputs -> outputs': required. NOT_READY blocks R8 (methodology/P10_publish_gate.md); PASS_WITH_NAMED_GAPS is a legal, honest outcome (requires named_gaps below), never silently rounded up to PASS.

answers.description: The ten questions verbatim from templates/paper/arxiv-twocol/main.tex:375-378 (one-fact-one-home: this schema does not restate the question text, only names the ten answer slots by the same order). Each is a free-text human answer -- presence-checked only, never correctness-checked (same presence-vs-correctness split as the bias register in methodology/P15_problem_first_and_responsibility.md).

named_gaps.description: Required, non-empty, when gate_status == PASS_WITH_NAMED_GAPS -- which of the ten questions the human could not answer unaided, named honestly rather than silently left as a filled-but-hollow answer.

ai_filled.description: P17 'Non-delegable': a filled-but-ai_filled-tagged answer is itself a NOT_READY condition, never a disclosed pass. If any answer was AI-assisted in wording only (never in substance), disclose it here honestly -- see allOf below (any non-empty entry here forces gate_status to NOT_READY).

allOf.description: PASS_WITH_NAMED_GAPS requires at least one named_gaps entry -- the honest-disclosure branch, never a silent PASS.
P17 'Non-delegable': any ai_filled answer disclosure forces gate_status to NOT_READY -- an AI-filled answer is never a disclosed pass, at any gate_status.
